mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_connection (connection_id, client_id, profile_code) VALUES (#{connectionId}, #{clientId}, #{profileCode})
mapper.select: SELECT connection_id, client_id, profile_code FROM mock_connection WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId}
SELECT connection_id, client_id, profile_code FROM mock_connection WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND profile_code = #{profileCode}
SELECT connection_id, client_id, profile_code, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at FROM mock_connection ORDER BY created_at DESC
